goalCandidates.hint: Moments in the video that are probably goals, found from the camera and the players. Watch the clip, then confirm the goal for a team or reject it. Rejected moments are kept and help to improve the detection.

goalCandidates.question: Goal?
goalCandidates.focusHint: The clip plays as soon as a candidate is up. 1 or 2 confirms, X rejects, U undoes, Enter plays again, Esc closes.
goalCandidates.rateHint: More proposals per minute of play find more goals but take longer to review.
goalCandidates.undoIdle: U takes back the last decision.

calibrate.title: Mark the court
calibrate.introMoving: The hall image is stitched from the whole video (the camera pans). Mark at least 4 points, ideally 6 to 8 spread over the whole court.
calibrate.introFixed: Mark at least 4 court points, ideally 6 to 8 spread over the whole court.
calibrate.pick: Now click in the hall image: {name}
calibrate.nearSide: The bottom of the sketch is the side where the camera stands.
calibrate.existing: Orange: the automatically detected court. If it is wrong, set the points again.
calibrate.error: The points could not be saved. Please try again.
calibrate.hint: Tip: court corners and goal posts on the floor are the most precise. To move a point, choose it in the sketch and click again.

landmarks.sixLeftNear: Left 6 m line, end camera side
landmarks.sixLeftFar: Left 6 m line, end far side
landmarks.sixRightNear: Right 6 m line, end camera side
landmarks.sixRightFar: Right 6 m line, end far side

calibrate.spread: The points are too close together: also mark points on both sidelines (e.g. the corners or the ends of the centre line). The goal posts alone are not enough; the court would be distorted.
calibrate.existingAuto: Found automatically. Does the orange court lie on the hall's lines with the goals in place? Then confirm, otherwise set points.
